EX-99.1 2 ea031145701ex99-1.htm TIZIANA LIFE SCIENCES LTD PRESS RELEASE, DATED NOVEMBER 9, 2026 Exhibit 99.1 Tiziana KOL Call Highlights Consistency Between Positive Phase 2a INFORM-MS Topline Results and Longer-Term Clinical Benefits Observed in Expanded Access Program for Patients with Non-Active Secondary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis Treated with Intranasal Foralumab BOSTON, MA, November 9, 2026 – Tiziana Life Sciences, Ltd.

(Nasdaq: TLSA) (“Tiziana” or the “Company”), a biotechnology company developing breakthrough immunomodulation therapies with its lead development candidate, intranasal foralumab, a fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody, today provided additional context on the positive topline results from its Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial, building on the Key Opinion Leader (KOL) investor call held on Monday, November 9, 2026.
